description: Batu Energy - Atlas SEN, open-source electricity system atlas is a dataset listed in Awesome Electrical Grid Mapping, a curated list of electrical grid maps, datasets and resources under the section "North America > National-level projects and resources", published or maintained by Batu Energy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT (as tagged in the list). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transmission and distribution network screening, hosting-capacity and grid planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-electrical-grid-mapping.
